$comment: KursoKo share character card — v5: flat vector 2D (questionnaire style), waist-up, same cast as landing RIASEC
asset_set: Results share collectible — one PNG per primary RIASEC archetype

global_rules.figure: loose waist-up — head to waist/hips; figure ~70% canvas height; ~10% top margin + ~15% bottom safe zone; NO legs, NO feet, NO shoes; nothing cropped at edges
global_rules.style: flat vector illustration — unDraw-inspired edu marketing, same as KursoKo questionnaire assets
global_rules.outline: thin 2px #2D2D2D ink on character, clothing, hair silhouette, and all props
global_rules.fill: solid flat color blocks — minimal cel shade only, NO gradients, NO texture grain
global_rules.face: minimal friendly face — two dot eyes, small curved smile, no detailed nose, not photorealistic
global_rules.proportions: realistic young adult — NOT chibi, NOT super-deformed
global_rules.poster: 640×640 square — cream #FDFCF8 base with soft RIASEC accent wash ~20% opacity edge to edge
global_rules.composition: single character centered; same cast/outfit/props as matching riasec-{letter}.json; optional faint grey decorative circles at ~15% opacity; NO floor line required for waist-up crop
global_rules.props: same minimal props as landing sticker — flat vector with 2px outline
global_rules.text_on_image: none — no RIASEC letter, no archetype name, no badge
global_rules.cast: SAME six characters as landing RIASEC stickers — questionnaire render style only
global_rules.generation_tip: fresh chat per archetype — attach 01.1.webp + 02.1.png + riasec-{letter}.json; do NOT attach other RIASEC card images

poster_background.accent_wash: ~20% opacity RIASEC accent over entire canvas
poster_background.optional_decor: 1–2 faint grey circles ~15% opacity — same as questionnaire scenes

deliverable.framing: loose waist-up; ~70% height; 15% bottom safe zone; props at chest/mid-torso — not flush to bottom
